title: ase.lattice: Avoid __getattr__()
body:
The Lattice objects used `__getattr__` to define things like `lattice.beta` which exist only for some lattices.

However this makes them unpicklable.  For multiprocessing it is nice that these relatively simple objects are picklable.  This MR replaces them using a different mechanism.
